claim: Rainfall is a major contributor to seasonal leaf abundance at Bezà.
authority_scope: gallery and xerophytic transects during the observed period
important_limit: correlation and seasonal covariation do not establish rainfall as the exclusive cue

claim: Gallery forest retains leaves later than xerophytic forest at Bezà.
important_limit: habitat contrast does not identify the causal water source

claim: Groundwater from the Sakamena may buffer gallery-forest phenology.
important_limit: groundwater level and rooting-zone access were not measured
temperature covaried seasonally; the study did not isolate an independent effect

claim: VPD is an observed causal driver of Bezà leaf transitions.
important_limit: site study did not calculate or isolate VPD; CAL-07D shows model sensitivity only

claim: Southwestern Madagascar phenology is heterogeneous across vegetation types and species, with ongoing water stress contributing to leaflessness.
important_limit: regional evidence does not transfer a single Bezà threshold

claim: Photoperiod is a plausible cue for some tropical dry-forest pre-rain leaf flushing.
important_limit: regional day-length association was not significant and broad analogue regimes differ from Bezà

claim: Stored stem water can support pre-rain leaf flush while stomata remain closed until soil water increases.
important_limit: genus-specific mechanism cannot be generalized to the Bezà ROI

claim: Soil-water availability and hydraulic traits can organize dry-forest leaf strategies.
important_limit: analogue does not authorize Madagascar parameters or equations

claim: PhenoCam 10/25/50 transition dates are relative thresholds of a fitted seasonal GCC amplitude.
important_limit: thresholds are not fractions of GSI, LAI, biomass, or canopy cover

claim: GCC transitions can disagree materially with in-situ leaf phenology and depend on ROI composition.
important_limit: reported offsets are not transferable correction factors for Bezà

claim: The CAL-07 retained transition file is a GCC_mean Data Record 7 product, while CAL-07D ancillary source context used smooth_gcc_90.
authority_scope: retained files and provisional public site archive processed 2026-07-26
important_limit: falling transition dates can differ materially between the two products; exact dates may change in later provider processing

claim: The admitted literature authorizes a production forcing correction, threshold refit, or new water-cue equation.
important_limit: evidence identifies contributors and measurements, not a unique production formulation

claim: Post-2011 direct-site records could discriminate recent camera chronology against field phenology and local weather.
important_limit: availability, variables, quality control, and exact dates remain unverified

claim: Dry years advance and wet years delay Bezà defoliation.
